classification: Existing contracts only, not a newly authored scientific comparison specification

baselines.fixed_selection_rule: Eligible fixed strategies meet 0.90 development clean coverage; minimize worst development decision loss; within 1e-8 minimize estimated cost then strategy_id.
baselines.greedy_scope: Existing coverage-aware selector initial_selected, reputation_weighted; complete selected team under matching minimum-one finalization. This isolates selection; it is not the separate adaptive non-game stopping pipeline.

metric_definitions.cost: measured individual attempt durations excluding initialization; historical selected-team estimates; full-roster collection is not singleton end-to-end latency
metric_definitions.decision_loss: (FA + FR + 0.2 * uncertain) / all examples; no resource penalty
metric_definitions.execution_failures: failed/unavailable selected attempts, and cases affected, with missing recordings distinguished
metric_definitions.false_accept: incorrect accepted / all 40, plus incorrect accepted / 20 incorrect examples
metric_definitions.false_reject: correct rejected / all 40, plus correct rejected / 20 correct examples
metric_definitions.selective_risk: (FA + FR) / decided; null if no decided examples

statistics.method: Paired cluster percentile bootstrap, resample 20 split_identity groups with replacement, retaining both correct/incorrect answers and paired methods
statistics.zero_decision_samples: risk undefined; disclose undefined fraction and omit risk CI if any bootstrap sample undefined
